releases.title: Firefox desktop compatibility
releases.summary: A Firefox release for desktop browsers, including Firefox 140 ESR. Firefox for Android remains unsupported.
preview: For Firefox on desktop, including Firefox 140 ESR.
Refresh open Twitch tabs after updating.
fixed: The Firefox package no longer declares support for Firefox for Android.
knownIssues: Supporter isn't on sale yet, and Sign in with Twitch is not available in this release.
Bookmarks, notes and watched history stay in the browser where you saved them.
Refresh open Twitch tabs after updating.
Moments you missed get a picture only if the stream has a Twitch VOD.

releases.title: Clearer moments and smoother replay charts
releases.summary: The panel leads with Top moments, moment rows show pictures, and replay charts follow the player. Charts appear sooner, labels are easier to read, and saved moments open at the right time. Supporter isn't on sale yet.
preview: Top moments comes first, with pictures on every moment row.
Replay charts follow the player, and live charts appear sooner.
Clearer times and labels; saved links open at the right second.
new: The panel opens on Top moments, putting the stream's strongest reactions first.
Every moment row has a picture, with a clear placeholder while its Twitch frame is loading or unavailable.
Replay charts follow the VOD player, so the readout stays with what you are watching.
The Community button switches to Chat and shows the community list.
After useful saves, the extension may ask once for a store review where a review link is available.
changed: Pages with nothing to chart stay on Chat instead of opening an empty Pulse panel.
improved: The chart appears sooner on load, and hovering it does less work.
Chart headings, viewer labels and status messages are easier to read and fit inside the panel.
Smaller 7TV emote images reduce the amount downloaded for the panel.
Account & Supporter screens explain the current connection and checkout state more clearly. Supporter isn't on sale yet.
fixed: Moment times and chart labels use the same clock, including moments near the edge of a stream.
A moment's picture stays put while its VOD id arrives or its rank changes.
Saved-moment links open the VOD at the right second.
The replay emote line no longer looks flat when activity changes.
When StreamPulse cannot be reached, Back to chat lets you return to Twitch chat.
Panel spacing, scrolling and keyboard focus behave more consistently.
knownIssues: Supporter isn't on sale yet, and Sign in with Twitch is not available in this release.
Bookmarks, notes and watched history stay in the browser where you saved them.
Refresh open Twitch tabs after updating.
Moments you missed get a picture only if the stream has a Twitch VOD.

releases.title: Whole-stream charts and moment pictures
releases.summary: Charts cover the whole stream, Top Moments shows pictures, even of moments you missed, and Stream Recap sums up a past stream. The 7TV header backdrop is a Supporter perk; accounts aren't open and Supporter isn't on sale yet.
preview: Top Moments shows a picture of what happened, even on past streams.
The 7TV header backdrop is a Supporter perk; Supporter is not on sale yet.
new: Moment pictures: Top Moments shows what was on screen, even for moments you missed, using the stream's Twitch VOD. Pictures are never uploaded.
Stream Recap: a past stream's summary, its chart, and its Top moments like on live.
Bookmarks work without an account and stay in this browser.
Moment cards have a Bookmark button, and a saved moment keeps its picture in this browser.
Each moment shows how far it beat the stream's usual, like 4.2× usual.
A new toolbar popup with live channels and your recent moments.
Join the Discord and Send feedback from quick settings and settings.
A Supporter preview in quick settings and settings shows what Supporter will add: title paint, a tenure crest, emote rain and a Supporter card, seen only by you. Supporter isn't on sale yet.
changed: The Default chart range setting is gone. Pick a range on the chart instead.
Replay top emotes count every emote provider, not just 7TV.
improved: Live charts and Top Moments keep updating while you watch.
Top Moments opens a card only when you pick one.
Settings are reorganised, and quick settings opens on the channel you're watching.
Fewer permissions: StreamPulse asks only for twitch.tv and api.streampulse.stream.
fixed: Offline channels show as offline, not as live or "Not tracked".
Live streams no longer look offline after an ad or a player error.
The viewer line shows the real viewer count.
Retry works, and Pulse says when StreamPulse can't be reached.
Replays show the right chart and time ranges.
Watched moments on replays are remembered again.
Pulse no longer hides chat, and stays off clip pages.
knownIssues: Accounts aren't open yet and Supporter isn't on sale yet. Accounts are coming with Continue with Twitch.
Bookmarks, notes and watched history stay in the browser where you saved them.
Refresh open Twitch tabs after updating.
Moments you missed get a picture only if the stream has a Twitch VOD.
Twitch's chat menus open behind the Pulse panel. Switch to the Chat tab to use them.

releases.title: Selected-minute clarity and complete extension settings
releases.summary: Exact bucket selection, honest viewer history, refined chart motion, validated Twitch VOD playback windows, and a complete responsive settings workspace.
preview: Selected minutes use a compact moment layout with exact metrics, top emotes, and player actions.
All charts open on Full stream with exact bucket locking.
Viewer lines preserve honest sampling gaps while settings stay synchronized across extension surfaces.
new: Clicking a chart bucket opens a compact selected-minute card with chat, emote, and viewer readouts plus Jump and Open Analytics actions.
Hovering the chart previews a bucket read-only, so a moving pointer never offers actions that vanish.
Top-emote thumbnails in the selected-minute card show a hover preview with the emote name, provider, and use count.
Viewer-sampler health is reported separately from API connectivity, distinguishing an older backend, disabled sampling, active writes, and failures.
improved: Live, offline, and VOD charts open on Full stream; changing the range affects only the current view.
The viewer lane draws one continuous line with no persistent dots, and a sampled zero stays a real observation.
Chart hover and lock now identify the exact bucket and its chat and emote bars.
Selected-minute metrics read Viewers, Chat/min, Emotes/min, with emote chips using a fixed multiplier count.
Quick settings on Twitch now include auto-update, branded accents, overlay placement, the chat-closed dock, and an expandable three-item What's new preview.
The full options page is now the complete settings home for Twitch controls, privacy and cache controls, updates, changelog history, and development-only tools.
The responsive settings workspace uses one normal scroll owner, synchronized immediate-save controls, and section navigation that adapts to narrow layouts.
Chart previews, selected minutes, range menus, and settings transitions use lightweight motion with reduced-motion support.
Live polling exposes its state, so a toggle issues exactly one request.
fixed: Full stream charts now merge recent chat, emote, and viewer minutes into retained history, and refresh game history after a live category change.
A locked bucket keeps its highlight and both bar lanes visible after the pointer leaves the plot, and clears on a second click.
Selecting a ranked Top Moment while a minute is locked no longer loses the click to the outside-click handler.
The viewer line no longer synthesises minutes before sampling began, and no longer overwrites sampled zeroes.
Chart downsampling no longer lends one minute's peak viewer count to a different minute's bar.
Emote thumbnails no longer flicker when moving between adjacent buckets.
Approximate clock prefixes were removed from moment times.
Viewer-sampling health now reaches the extension UI, including hosted and local mode drift.
Offline and VOD recap charts honour the reduced-motion preference.
VOD timelines and moments are constrained to the exact Twitch playback window, so corrupt outlier minutes cannot stretch the chart or issue impossible seeks.
Opening overlay settings reuses the cached health result, while the Test button still performs an explicit fresh check.
The Volt accent now renders with its intended orange palette across quick and full settings instead of the previous green treatment.
knownIssues: Viewer history is collected prospectively; minutes missed before sampling was enabled are not backfilled.
A live stream may not expose a VOD id until Twitch publishes the archive after the stream ends.
